tasks.spec: Implement all endpoints per contracts.md section 3, payment gate per section 4, publish flow per section 5. Use Minimal API + endpoint groups. tasks.title: Integration + unit + architecture + contract tests

Architecture test: every entity in CourseDomain inherits TenantEntity; CourseDbContext has global filter on TenantId. Contract test for CoursePublished record shape.

tasks.title: Tenant isolation + auth audit
tasks.spec: Run the tenant-isolation skill across CourseService. Verify: (a) every read uses the global query filter AND has explicit TenantId predicate in repos; (b) no endpoint trusts a body-supplied TenantId; (c) consumers honour message TenantId; (d) no JWT validation downstream — only X-* headers; (e) public catalogue endpoints don't leak Draft courses or cross-tenant rows; (f) payment gate cannot be bypassed.
acceptance: audit report with zero high-severity findings
